newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says may lower POSCO debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may lower POSCO debt ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it had placed the A2 senior unsecured debt ratings of Pohang Iron & Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) for possible downgrade in light of the company's recent announcement of its intention to acquire assets of Hanbo Steel Co.

Moody's acknowledged POSCO's relatively stable operating profile and dominant position in the South Korean domestic steel sector, but added that the review was being made because of the impact of the possible Hanbo purchase.

Moody's also said the review was being conducted in light of the continued sluggishness in the South Korean economy, a potential future over-capacity in the global steel market as well as a potential weakness in the sovereign credit quality of South Korea, which owns about 34 percent of POSCO.
